svg.title: What the world map's screen reads
svg.desc: Above, the world map's screen as Isaac leaves Vale, tilted into perspective, with five of its lines picked out in colour from the top of the screen to the bottom. Below, the same part of the world laid flat, with Vale and Vault marked. A trapezoid around Isaac shows the part of the flat map the screen reads: each coloured screen line reads the straight strip of the same colour. The lines near the top of the screen read strips that are farther away and wider, so the area read is a trapezoid, wide at the far end.
svg.text: Each screen line reads one straight strip of
the flat map. Lines higher on the screen read
farther and wider strips: together, a trapezoid.
